title: Cities Skylines | Franklin Episode 7: Liberalism
premise: During water-enabled expansion, donoteat01 argues that liberal freedom promises coexist with property protection, labor exploitation, and exclusions, and that neoliberalism revives these mechanisms. Prison-strike solidarity supplies stakes. Claims attributed to presenter.
coverage: Full machine transcript read; all 26 contact sheets and 301 indexed frames inspected. First frame per 5-second bin plus scene score >0.30 at480px. Twelve native-resolution stills resolve factory/pay signs, crafting/pay inventory, Rand, damaged hotel, rights caveat, Sanders, and convention composite. Sparse samples cannot establish every brief gag or continuous motion. Full speech is source-derived by the shared renderer from every ASR word, not manually excerpted or human-verified audio. Static inserts/uncertain identities labelled. Sound arrays only annotate metadata-credited music with approximate association; empty arrays mean unannotated, not silence.
